```yaml
name: GPU Reset

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  gpu-test:
    name: Run GPU tests
    runs-on: [self-hosted, rocm, 8gpus]
    timeout-minutes: 60

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'
          activate-environment: iris
          ignore-empty-workdir: true
          enable-cache: true
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install project
        run: uv sync --dev

      - name: Run all-gather tests
        run: |
          torchrun --nproc_per_node=8 -m pytest -k all_gather
        env:
          PYTHONPATH: ${{ github.workspace }}
```

name: GPU Reset

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  gpu-test:
    name: Run GPU tests
    runs-on: [self-hosted, rocm, 8gpus]
    timeout-minutes: 60

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'
          activate-environment: iris
          ignore-empty-workdir: true
          enable-cache: true
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install project
        run: uv sync --dev

      - name: Run all-gather tests
        run: |
          torchrun --nproc_per_node=8 -m pytest -k all_gather
        env:
          PYTHONPATH: ${{ github.workspace }}
